haau3 Research looks for ways to make caregiving better. Much of the work measures how AI models
answer health questions, starting with questions about medications. We begin with small
experiments and publish each one as a short note: what we tried, the code, the run logs, the
results with their uncertainty, and what it cost.

Everything here is open for anyone to learn from and build on. Every patient in this work is
synthetic. No real person's health data is used.
